name: wikifunctions_usage_wikis
comment: Normalised (using wiki, namespace) dimension for wikifunctions_usage, so the using wiki's ID and namespace name aren't repeated on every usage row. One row per distinct (using wiki, namespace) pair, referenced from wikifunctions_usage by wfu_wiki_id. Lives on the shared x1 cluster via the 'virtual-wikifunctions-usage' virtual domain. Modelled on JsonConfig's globaljsonlinks_wiki table.

columns.name: wfuw_namespace_id
columns.comment: The using page's namespace ID on the using wiki, for filtering

columns.name: wfuw_namespace_text
columns.comment: The using page's namespace name on the using wiki, for display (the foreign namespaces may not match the local ones); null for the main namespace. Functionally dependent on (wfuw_wiki, wfuw_namespace_id), so kept out of the unique key.

indexes.name: wfuw_wiki_namespace
indexes.comment: Resolve and dedupe the (wiki, namespace) dimension to its surrogate id
